fixesApplied: npm audit fix: eliminated 14 security vulnerabilities (1 critical, 7 high, 5 moderate, 1 low) in package tree
tsconfig.app.json & tsconfig.node.json: enforced strict: true mode across all modules
vite.config.ts: fixed path traversal vulnerability in /api/upload via path.basename and directory boundary check
vite.config.ts: introduced readBoundedBody with payload limits (25MB uploads, 5MB JSON) preventing memory exhaustion DoS
vite.config.ts & mcp-bridge.mjs: implemented SSRF protection via isSafeHttpUrl banning loopback, private ranges and AWS/GCP metadata IPs
mcp-bridge.mjs: added clean termination listeners (SIGINT, SIGTERM, process exit) preventing orphaned child processes
public/audio-processor.js: added null-safe guard for inputs and channels avoiding TypeError
src/main.tsx: added safe root DOM check and replaced process.env with import.meta.env.PROD
